Hi Karthik and Liz,

Thanks for the detailed note. Below is a concise validation checklist and expected timeline — we'll kick off formal validation once the offer is submitted in Partner Center.

Minimum required items for an AI inference offer:
- Publisher account in Partner Center (completed)
- Offer manifest (JSON) and technical description
- Container registry access (Acr or Docker Hub) with a tagged image that boots successfully in Linux consumption VM
- ARM template or marketplace VM image for single-click deploy (if applicable)
- Public sample endpoint or smoke test script (curl + example payload)
- Security/compliance docs: SOC2 type II report (if available) or equivalent statements, data residency notes, retention policy
- Runtime resource guide: minimum GPU/CPU, memory, supported CUDA/cuDNN versions
- Licensing & pricing metadata and SKU mapping (MSFT requires explicit SKU IDs)

Typical tech validation window: 5–7 business days from when we can access the image and run the smoke tests. If there are networking or image access issues, that can add another 3–5 days.

Common failure points we see with inference workloads:
- Container does not expose expected port or health endpoint
- Image pulls require auth and the credentials are not provided (please provide a temporary SAS or read-only token)
- Long cold-start times causing smoke tests to time out (increase readiness timeout or optimize entrypoint)
- Missing GPU drivers or mismatched CUDA versions in the image

Next steps we recommend:
1) Submit offer draft in Partner Center and add marketplace-support@microsoft.com as a reviewer.
2) Upload a smoke-test artifact and provide a short runbook (how to start, expected port, sample request).
3) Provide a temporary read-only token to the container registry for validation.

For contract signatures / co-sell registration, we will route you to the co-sell team once validation passes (DocuSign link provided here): https://www.docusign.com/sign?token=abcd-1234-efgh

Regards,
Carmen Liu
Azure Marketplace Technical Validation
Microsoft Corporation
